title: linaria × sepium var. ochroleuca
intro: Linaria × sepium var. ochroleuca, commonly known as the Yellow Toadflax, is a hybrid plant species that belongs to the borage family (Boraginaceae). This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including respiratory problems, such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its health benefits, which include soothing inflammation and reducing cough. The therapeutic actions of Yellow Toadflax include its antispasmodic, antitussive, and expectorant properties, which help to relax muscles, suppress coughs, and facilitate the removal of mucus from the airways. The bioactive constituents of Yellow Toadflax include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
